purpose: Exactly two new user-started visits on the unchanged public-policy forest, measuring actual emitted decisions and browser receipt latency. No fitting, replacements or automatic capture.

expected_policy.note: Refusal threshold fitted only on historical CESNET calibration, not local traffic. Scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities; no unknown-service guarantee.

network_context.limits: Current dual-family TCP reachability checked; hotspot identity user-declared, no campus transfer claim.

browser_session_policy: All Chrome processes closed before each intent; reopen normal Chrome after intent. Start stripped NetLog, then app capture, then fresh target navigation. Stop both; keep Chrome open until archive verifies process lifetimes.
eligibility: Existing mapped-valid-prefix packet/socket/reference QC. Retain all eligible supported flows and refusal inventories, independent of model output. One complete target IPv6 flow per visit.
collection: Temporary validation app8002, Wi-Fi9, reference ON, longer windows OFF. Edge viewer plus normal Chrome stripped NetLog/target; close other Chrome tabs. Target activity60s, capture limit120s. No deliberate background load; incidental traffic preserved. Model/policy fixed before packets arrive.
primary: Actual emitted ten-packet decisions on independently referenced target-service flows in their target visits. Denominator is all eligible target flows reaching ten packets; missing emitted checkpoints are separately counted and never filled with replay. Report conditional model acceptance and end-to-end acceptance separately. Full-prefix replay is secondary only.
latency: For all actual native events, report sample counts and p50/p95 capture-to-parser, queue, prediction pipeline, capture-to-event and capture-to-browser-receipt separately. Browser receipt is not paint. No numeric hard-latency pass target; require nonempty backend and browser receipt samples plus no drops/evidence eviction for operational screen.
scoring: Only after both usable archives. Verify source replay matches emitted native labels/scores. No calibration, training, policy changes, old study inputs or public data. Preserve both a raw/probability replay diagnostic and actual-live-only acceptance metrics.
attempts: One YouTube then one Instagram visit on the same local date after declaration; one attempt per slot. Genuine QC/support failure stops scope; processor failures preserve same attempt. No replacement or extra recording. Stop this scope on failed quality/operational screen without retuning.
limits: Small two-service same-hotspot prospective operational/policy check, not population accuracy, correctness probability, open-world detection or hard real-time guarantee. Existing four-visit evaluation stays sealed. Temporary preview does not replace the normal B17 startup default. User alone presses Start.
